title: Introduce schema-backed onboarding fingerprint and changelog delta preview
author: Ava Patel
description: Motivation: Onboarding new model variants often produces noisy release notes and flaky changelog diffs because metadata ordering, minor formatting, or non-functional attributes change the generated delta. This PR introduces a schema-backed deterministic fingerprint for onboarding manifests and a changelog delta previewer so reviewers can quickly see human-readable behavioral changes before merging. The fingerprint combines normalized manifest fields, a stable canonical serialization, and a compact performance-profile hash to make onboard diffs stable across formatting-only edits. The changelog previewer is available as a CLI flag (--changelog-preview) and as a preview endpoint in the registry UI. Checklist: [x] implement canonical serializer and fingerprint calculation; [x] add lightweight manifest linter (required fields + alias normalization); [x] add changelog delta preview generator; [x] add unit tests for fingerprint stability and unicode model names; [x] wire preview URL into PR body template; [x] update docs and developer quickstart. Related work: ENG-2145 (onboard stability), ENG-3221 (release automation).
commits_summary: 3 commits: (1) runtime: add canonicalizer and fingerprint generator for onboard manifests; (2) cli/ui: add --changelog-preview and preview endpoint renderer; (3) tests/docs: add stability unit tests, unicode name coverage, and docs updates
review_thread: Diego Morales: Nice approach, the canonicalizer should make diffs readable. Can you add a short note on collision risk and mitigation?
Ava Patel: Added section in docs explaining collision bounds and fallback to full-content diff if hash matches unexpectedly; added test covering synthetic collision scenario.
Lena Fischer: Please ensure alias normalization preserves user-visible aliases in UI; don't silently rewrite without warning.
Ava Patel: Alias normalization is non-destructive now: we store a normalized key for fingerprinting but keep original alias list intact in manifest output. Added unit test for roundtrip.
Marcus Nguyen: Found a failure with a model alias containing emoji in the first CI run; tests were updated and re-run, CI passed afterwards.
Lena Fischer: Approved after docs update.
Diego Morales: Approved — merging via squash once CI green.
release_notes: Add deterministic onboard manifest fingerprint to stabilize changelogs; add CLI and UI changelog delta preview; introduce manifest linter and alias normalization to reduce noisy diffs; add migration to index fingerprints for fast lookup; update docs and PR template to include changelog preview URL.
performance_profile_sample: Fingerprint incorporates a compact sample of the model's baseline perf profile (p50 latency, p95 tail, token throughput) so small formatting edits don't perturb performance-aware diffs.
motivation: Reduce noisy release notes and make reviewer intent explicit by presenting a concise behavioral delta prior to merge. This lowers review time for model onboarding and reduces accidental regressions in perf metadata.
notes_for_ops: Add new DB index migration (202411_add_fingerprint_index.sql) to the registry migration plan; forward-compat note added for private deployments to opt out of preview generation via config flag 'changelog.preview.enabled=false'.
qa_notes: Unit tests cover unicode aliases, collision synthetic case, and fingerprint stability across ordering and whitespace changes. Manual QA: create two manifests differing only in field ordering and verify preview shows no functional delta.
